title: 14th BRICS Science, Technology & Innovation Ministerial Adopts Chennai Declaration
detail: India hosted the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting in Chennai, concluding August 21, 2026 under India's 2026 BRICS Chairship, with the adoption of the Chennai Declaration. Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology and Earth Sciences Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the ministerial and delivered the inaugural address, calling for deeper BRICS cooperation in frontier technologies including AI, quantum computing and biotechnology, innovation financing, and talent mobility. Delegations from Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and the UAE participated. Singh highlighted India's National Quantum Mission, National Supercomputing Mission and Digital Public Infrastructure ecosystem as models for expanded frontier-research and startup partnerships under the Chairship theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.'

title: BRICS Tourism Ministers Adopt Jaipur Declaration
detail: India's Ministry of Tourism hosted the BRICS Tourism Track under its 2026 Chairship, culminating in the Tourism Ministers' Meeting in Jaipur on August 21, 2026, chaired by Union Minister for Culture and Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat. Ministers and delegations from Brazil, Iran, South Africa, the UAE, China, Ethiopia, Indonesia and Russia adopted the Jaipur Declaration (BRICS Tourism Ministers' Communique 2026) by consensus, building on the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group meeting held August 19 and chaired by Tourism Secretary Bhuvnesh Kumar. The Declaration commits to four priorities: AI and tourism; sustainability and responsible tourism; tourism skilling and capacity building; and tourism exchanges and seamless travel facilitation, recognizing the potential of 'responsible, safe and human-centred artificial intelligence' to transform the sector. Delegates toured Jaipur heritage sites including Hawa Mahal, City Palace and Amber Palace on August 20.
